title: Apex Affinity Group — Insurance Marketing Organization
subtitle: Helping Independent Agents Grow Their Business

sections.title: Who We Are
sections.content: Apex Affinity Group is a national insurance marketing organization (IMO) that provides independent life and health insurance agents with top-tier carrier contracts, advanced training, and technology tools to grow their business. Founded in 2018, Apex has grown to support over 1,200 agents across all 50 states.

sections.title: What We Offer
sections.content: Street-level and above contracts with 45+ A-rated carriers. In-house case design and underwriting support. Proprietary CRM and lead management platform. Weekly training webinars and annual conference. Co-op marketing programs. Real-time commission tracking and advance programs.

sections.title: Products
sections.content: Life Insurance: Term, Whole Life, IUL, Final Expense. Health Insurance: ACA, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, Dental/Vision. Annuities: Fixed, Fixed Indexed, MYGA. Specialty: Disability Income, Long-Term Care, Group Benefits.

sections.title: Agent Success Stories
sections.content: Maria Gonzalez, Austin TX: 'I went from $80K to $185K in my first year with Apex. The case design support alone is worth it.' James Patterson, Atlanta GA: 'The carrier access changed everything. I was captive before — now I can actually shop for my clients.' Priya Sharma, Chicago IL: 'The weekly training keeps me sharp. I placed my first IUL case within 60 days of joining.'

sections.title: Technology Platform
sections.content: Apex Connect CRM: Manage leads, track policies, automate follow-ups. E-App integration with 30+ carriers. Quote comparison engine for life, health, and annuity products. Client portal for policy access and service requests. Mobile app for on-the-go quoting and submissions.

bulletPoints: No production requirements — keep your contracts even if you take a month off
Dedicated case designer assigned to every agent
Monthly bonus programs above standard commission
Annual Apex Summit conference with top industry speakers
additionalNotes: Headquarters: Dallas, TX. Regional offices in Atlanta, Chicago, and Phoenix.
